# Core paths — the single source of truth for DCR's core (CLAUDE.md Hard rule 1).
# Core = the balance calculations and the monthly roll-over. Read by
# scripts/core-guard.mjs (the "Core guard" check, .github/workflows/core-guard.yml).
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line under a [group] header. A path ending
# in "/" matches everything below that directory; any other path matches exactly.
# Lines starting with "#" and blank lines are ignored.
#
# Groups:
#   code          the engine and the roll-over. Any change needs core-change-approved.
#   expectations  the golden master. Newly added files under a directory entry pass
#                 without the label when no code changed; any other change needs it.
#                 A code change together with any expectations change gets the
#                 combined failure (the golden master would prove nothing).
#   guard         the guard itself. Any change needs core-change-approved.

[code]
src/lib/balance.ts
src/lib/monthStatus.ts
src/lib/rollover.ts
src/components/register/RegisterView.tsx
# Whole file: the guard can't single out useMostRecentRegisterBefore (auto-carry source).
src/hooks/useRegister.ts

[expectations]
src/lib/__fixtures__/golden/
src/lib/golden.test.ts

[guard]
.github/core-paths.txt
.github/workflows/core-guard.yml
scripts/core-guard.mjs
